property_summary: When any address (non-owner) calls sudicideAnyone, the reference contract reverts due to onlyOwner modifier, leaving a positive contract balance; the buggy version selfdestructs and sends all Ether to the caller, resulting in address(c).balance == 0 and the contract being destroyed.
change_summary: Remove the __onlyOwner modifier from sudicideAnyone, allowing any caller to selfdestruct the contract.
